# MATERIAL DISCLOSURE: Council outputs for HS2 and Crossrail explicitly invoke reference-class base rates in the Risk Agent section (addressing the D4 gap identified in the BER pilot). The operator (Claude in this session) read the BER pilot score before producing HS2 and Crossrail Council outputs. The routing rules always mapped reference-class forecasting to the Risk Agent
column2: faithfully invoking it on cases where a reference class was available is within the system's native behaviour. But a stricter reading is that scorer observation of the BER D4 gap nudged later Council outputs toward closing it. This is the designer-as-scorer confound anticipated in limitations.md §1. See PILOT-NOTES.md and findings.md §7 for full treatment.
